summary: Tested shot modal redesign, scoreboard team logos/colors, player stats table styling, and payment modal features. Backend tests: 9/9 passed. Frontend UI testing was limited due to session expiration issues between browser automation calls.

Shot modal has editable time input field with data-testid='shot-time-input' (lines 1840-1849)
Shot modal header shows team logo and uses team color for background (lines 1745-1767)
Scoreboard shows team logos (lines 2278-2283, 2401-2406) and uses team colors (lines 2275, 2287, 2291-2294)
Player stats table header shows team logo and uses team color (lines 2789-2822)
PaymentModal has 3-column grid of payment method buttons: Cash, Check, Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, Cash App, Stripe, Other (lines 1133-1177)
Check number field only appears when paymentMethod === 'check' (lines 1179-1191)
Payment link button appears for digital payment methods (lines 1193-1208)
Backend payment endpoint accepts paymentMethod and checkNumber fields (line 683 in teams.py)
